note: AP2 can carry x402 as a payment method through the a2a-x402 extension launched on 2025-09-16; its embedded flow targets AP2 v0.1 mandates (CartMandate), which AP2 v0.2 no longer has. The AP2 repository ships x402 samples.
ERC-8004 registration files carry an x402Support flag, feedback files can carry proofOfPayment for an x402 payment, and best practices use agentWallet as the x402 receipt address.
MPP maps x402 exact onto its charge intent, and mppx can serve both protocols on one route; Stripe sits on the x402 TSC and co-created MPP.
Both offer HTTP 402 machine payments for agents; Visa and Artemis measured MPP far below x402 to 2026-04-21 (secondary report).

The TAP specification defines a browsingIOU object an agent sends when a merchant answered with 402; TAP samples use non-standard X-Payment headers rather than the x402 wire format. Visa is a Premier member of the x402 Foundation.
Mastercard is a Premier member of the x402 Foundation, which runs a card-acceptance working group; no technical link to Agent Pay was found.
